# Apex Conclave

> Apex Conclave is a student-led events and competitions brand in India. It creates platforms for high school and college students to compete, collaborate and showcase their abilities through competitions, conferences and experiences. Diplovia 2026, a virtual Model United Nations, is its first and currently only event; new formats are coming soon.

## Diplovia 2026 (virtual Model UN)

- Dates: 22 and 23 November 2026, two days, 100% online
- Who can join: high school and college students, roughly ages 15 to 23; prior MUN experience helps but is not required
- Committees (five): UNSC, WHO, UNHRC, UNGA and a Historical Crisis Committee on the Cuban Missile Crisis of 1962
- Delegate fee: Early Bird ₹299 until 5 November 2026; regular ₹399 from 6 November 2026; paid by UPI
- Registration: open now at https://apexconclave.com/register?event=diplovia-2026. Delegates list two committee and country preferences; the team assigns seats and confirms by email after checking the payment
- Refunds: fees are non-refundable, except a full refund if Apex Conclave cancels the event (https://apexconclave.com/terms)
- Event page with agendas and FAQ: https://apexconclave.com/events/diplovia-2026

## Pages

- [Home](https://apexconclave.com/): what Apex Conclave is, its event verticals, the featured event, team and partnerships
- [Event Verticals](https://apexconclave.com/verticals): Diplomacy & MUNs (active, Diplovia 2026); new formats coming soon
- [Events](https://apexconclave.com/events): every event, upcoming and past
- [Diplovia 2026](https://apexconclave.com/events/diplovia-2026): virtual MUN on 22 and 23 November 2026; committees, agendas, fees, allotment and FAQ
- [About](https://apexconclave.com/about): mission, the people it brings together, team and how events are run
- [Partners](https://apexconclave.com/partners): sponsorships, college partnerships, competition challenges, judges and mentors, campus communities
- [FAQ](https://apexconclave.com/faq), [Contact](https://apexconclave.com/contact) and [Terms](https://apexconclave.com/terms)
